content:
sophie: Quick check-in from me — did an overnight eval sweep for the new onboarded-microq model. Found a cluster of regressions on our conversational prompt set (esp. clarifying Qs). Putting the diffs in the repo now. Blocking: need a small prompt rewrite + a gating decision on whether to ship the 8-bit quant.
ashok: Thx. Can you paste the worst failing example?
kevin: pinging for CR review on PR #482 (kv-cache fix). It's tiny but touches the cache invalidation around prefix caching. Needs one more :eyes:.
sophie: Worst example: "User: can you summarize this code?" -> model drops function names, hallucinating details. Eval delta: accuracy down 6.8% on clarifying intents suite. Logs: `resp_seq=... missing_identifier: true`
maria: Re: PR #482 — I can take a look after standup. If kv-cache is off by one it might explain the name drop when prefix tokens get misaligned.
liu: I pulled the eval artifacts, looks like tokenshift at step 3 when using microq quant. Might be quantization-induced embedding drift. I can run a small ablation (float16 vs 8-bit) on the same seed. ETA ~2hrs.
sophie: Nice — if it's quant-related we should gate the model. I proposed a conservative rollback in the rollout policy — can we decide today?
ashok: +1 to gating. Also, I noticed the prompt set had a recent tweak: removed explicit "include function names" hint. That might combine with kv issue to amplify drop.
kevin: I repro locally with a small script: ```bash
python reproduce.py --model onboarded-microq --seed 42 --prompt-file tests/clarify_prompts.txt
``` Output shows shifted tokens around the 2nd response. Pushing results to the PR for visibility.
sophie: Thanks Kevin, can you attach the minimal repro to the PR as a test? If we get CI failing reproducibly we can fast-block the rollout.
kevin: yep will add test.
maria: Review notes on #482: one nit on variable name and one suggested unit test. Overall LGTM pending test.
liu: Ablation done: float16 run keeps accuracy steady, 8-bit run matches the regression. Quant profile probably needs different calibration for this model. I'll dump the per-layer scale stats.
sophie: Good — that's actionable. For today's plan: 1) Kevin adds test + small fix; 2) Liu runs layer calib and posts calibration config; 3) I will draft a temporary gating rule (rollback to last stable v12 and block 8-bit variant) and post to rollout channel.
ashok: I'm free to pair on the prompt rewrite if you want. Quick suggestion: re-add an explicit anchor line like "List the function names first" and see effect.
sophie: Please do — if prompt tweak recovers >3% we can do quick hotfix while calib runs.
eval-bot: nightly-eval finished for onboarded-microq — metrics: clarifying_intent: baseline 0.842 -> 0.774 (delta -0.068), strict_match: 0.901 -> 0.894 (delta -0.007). Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/onboarded-microq/2123456789/
deploy-bot: Rollout event: onboarded-microq v13 started (5% ramp) at 2123456000. Current success rate: 98.9%
sophie: Oh — rollout started yesterday. I'll post an emergency pause on the rollout until we confirm.
kevin: On it, pausing via console now. :thumbsup:
maria: Once paused, I'll run the kv-cache unit test matrix across v12/v13 and quant configs. Should have results in ~90m.
sophie: Great. If anyone sees other weird samples drop them here (single-line is fine). Thanks all — will update this thread as things land.
